posts.body:
Hope I'm aloud to do this any my apologies to Rob if not.  I've just created a website and would be grateful for any comments/suggestions.  There is still a fair bit of work I need to do with it but hey, Rome wasnt built in a day!! LOL
thanks peeps
Alison
x
www.cheekytotschildcare.co.uk

hi alison
i have a mrsite site too 🙂  it does take time but i'm sure you'll get there.
I love the header too!
Best of luck
Gemma
all the text under the heading banner is all bunched up and can't be read properly - think it will need a smaller font or another bracket return

[QUOTE FROM ANOTHER POST] Rich said: all the text under the heading banner is all bunched up and can't be read properly - think it will need a smaller font or another bracket return
[/QUOTE] I see what you mean 😀 , will add that to my list of things to do tomorrow ... too tired to do anymore to it now and have to be up at 6.30am 🙁 Thanks for your input too Gemma, is yours a big site?? Alison x
the info is great...but i dont like the italic font and maybe the colour (but that may just be me) I found it quite difficult to read. Good luck, keep us updated as it all comes together! xXx

Moved to WAHM forum - but I have no problem with regular members talking about their own site on this forum - after all you deserve recognition for your hard efforts! The only thing I'm not prepared to put up with is people signing up just to spam their own site and not contribute to the community!
I like your site - needs a few tweaks as people have mentioned.. if you want any advice on how to promote it then just let me know 🙂

Many thanks Rob, may well hold you to your offer of helping me to promote it  😀
Alison
x

hi alison
this is mine
www.childrensbooks4u.co.uk
although havn't really improved it in months as i'm switching to a new site shortly as usborne copyright regulations have changed and they now provide templated sites.  I do love mrsite though and will be sad when i have to turn off all my work by the end of the month.
If your struggling with anything let me know and i'll do my best, there is also a forum on mrsite which is great for getting help with stuff...i even have very VERY basic html code on mine now for the scrolling text/pictures.
it does take hours and hours but i loved doing it and am pleased with the outcome.

wow, Gemma that is fantastic, well done.  I love your site.  May well pop by asking for tips in the next few days!! lol  😀
Alison
x

On the price page there are question marks in front of the amounts.
Don't know if it's just the colors i don't like but look of site was a bit boring. (not criticizing, just want to help with input) Maybe try having a pic on the main page of you with some of the kids...

Hi there, thanks for the input.  Not had much time lately to alter the site but am at home recuperating at the moment so will have more time over next few days.
As for pics with kids, I wont be putting on any of the children I have in my care as the parents wont allow it - which in this day and age with it being an open website I can fully understand.  Other pictures will be going on though  😀

Okay, have done a bit more updating today.  New thoughts please  😀
